text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Police representatives from several African countries meet in Algiers to hammer out a strategy to fight the spread of drug trafficking on the continent and related crimes. International Interpol police chief Raymond Kendall says the gathering was also a display of solidarity with the Algerian police in their struggle against "terrorism".
- Security forces kill seven "terrorists" in Houach Germain, south of Algiers, suspected of having taken part in the massacres of more than 40 people in the area 10 days ago.
- The three-party coalition government will present its programme before the National Assembly (lower house) on Saturday.
- Algerian economic growth will reach seven percent by the year 2000.
